# dsm_reverse_proxy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing DSM reverse proxy entry by description. The nested source and destination values are flattened here because a data source has nothing to configure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_reverse_proxy" "nextcloud" {
  description = "Nextcloud"
}

output "nextcloud_upstream" {
  value = "${lower(data.dsm_reverse_proxy.nextcloud.destination_protocol)}://${data.dsm_reverse_proxy.nextcloud.destination_hostname}:${data.dsm_reverse_proxy.nextcloud.destination_port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Entry description to look up.

### Read-Only

- `access_control_profile` (String) Name of the attached access control profile, if any.
- `access_control_profile_id` (String) UUID of the attached access control profile, or an empty string.
- `custom_headers` (Map of String) Custom request headers, excluding the WebSocket pair reported by `websocket`.
- `destination_hostname` (String) Destination hostname or IP address.
- `destination_port` (Number) Destination TCP port.
- `destination_protocol` (String) Destination protocol, `HTTP` or `HTTPS`.
- `hsts` (Boolean) Whether HSTS is enabled on the source listener.
- `http2` (Boolean) Whether HTTP/2 is enabled on the source listener. Reported as `false` when DSM does not expose the flag.
- `id` (String) Reverse proxy entry UUID assigned by DSM.
- `proxy_connect_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait when connecting to the destination.
- `proxy_intercept_errors` (Boolean) Whether DSM replaces destination error responses with its own.
- `proxy_read_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for a response from the destination.
- `proxy_send_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait while sending a request to the destination.
- `source_hostname` (String) Source hostname served by DSM.
- `source_port` (Number) Source TCP port.
- `source_protocol` (String) Source protocol, `HTTP` or `HTTPS`.
- `websocket` (Boolean) Whether the WebSocket upgrade headers are present.
